ADDED TO CALENDAR FOR PLAINTIFF'S ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE RE: PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION HEARING SET FOR APR-14-2011 AT 09:30 AM IN DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: PLAINTIFF EBRAHIM JALILI'S ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR THE ISSUANCE OF A PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION IS DENIED. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT SHOWN A LIKELIHOOD OF SUCCESS ON THE MERITS. THE TEMPORARY RESTRAINING ORDER IS VACATED AND THE OSC IS DISSOLVED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER.
